design_status: prospectively specified exploratory follow-up; runtime/source binding required before search
motivation: Test sparse editing with an explicit batch-matched activation measurement contract after v1 revealed batch-sensitive replay. This is a new numerical runtime and new baseline, not a retroactive correction of v1 outcomes.

environment.instruction: Stack the yellow block on the red block
environment.serving: Every actual native batch pads to16, including small/reduced live batches; original request ordering and first-real-request padding preserved.

capture_contract.native_noise: Concatenate normal(key(seed_i),(1,H,D)) per real request, then pad by first real request; never one key over the whole batch.
capture_contract.replay: Replay entire actual recorded packet at padded batch16, validate every real position, then extract requested item traces.

selection.reference: original v2 base cohort, never v1

heldout.order: Explicit base-vs-identical-base comparison, then unique accepted edited deployments in round order. Each has64 fresh base+64 candidate with fixedABBA32 blocks. If all incumbentsbase, only128-episode identity comparison.
heldout.capacity_formula: 128 * (1 + U2), U2=unique accepted edited deployments across3 rounds
heldout.runtime_controls: No new threshold tuning; fixed0.5 in both arms
heldout.generalization_scope: Previously unseen policy-noise streams in same fixed scene; not novel objects or layouts

analysis.mcnemar: exact two-sided exploratory; no confirmatory significance claim
analysis.shared_estimates: Role labels reuse one unique-policy estimate and are not independent tests or learning-step measurements
analysis.curves: Show proposal and accepted-incumbent development scores periteration; heldout labels annotated with shareddeploymentidentity
analysis.causality: Newruntime/baseline changes prevent attributing v1-to-v2 differences to weightediting

failure_policy.failed_runtime_validation: Record failure and stop v2 before editor launch; v1.1 final scoring still runs
failure_policy.partial_search: Retain all evidence and costs, freeze no-more-search status; do not call it a completed3-round loop

validation_before_search: frozen v1 source hashes remain unchanged
nativefixed16 identity and instrumentedwholepacket replay pass declared gates on bounded operator-only validation inputs
fresh32-episode v2 baseline complete with immutable batch-packet provenance
budget_scope: One32-base+96candidate exploratorysearch plus128*(1+U2)heldout episodes; setup/probe costs recorded separately. No secondtask or secondeditor comparison is implied.
